features.title: Configure Cursor ACP instances by credential reference
features.summary: Register bounded uniquely identified Cursor ACP instances with a credential alias and credential kind while never storing a secret value in plugin configuration.

configuration.constraints: At most 32 instances; each id is 1 to 64 characters matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*$.
Credential alias from 1 to 64 characters matching ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$.

failureModes: Duplicate or malformed instance data is rejected.
Status listing never launches Cursor or authenticates an account.

features.title: Create, resume, prompt, and cancel ACP sessions
features.summary: Drive Cursor through managed ACP stdio while DSH owns Agent/session lifecycle, resume existing sessions without duplicating creation, stream responses, and cancel active prompts.
failureModes: Image/fork/rollback/MCP inputs are refused when unsupported.
A provider interruption after prompt dispatch is marked uncertain and never replayed automatically.

externalDependencies.boundary: Cursor executable, ACP stdio protocol, and credential service.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Use the checked-in fake ACP executable with synthetic test credentials and scratch configuration only; never launch real Cursor.

features.title: Require explicit approval and confirm uncertain operations
features.summary: Map provider permission requests to DSH approval, allow only allow-once, and require durable exact-receipt confirmation before clearing uncertain work.
failureModes: Unsupported or ambiguous permission decisions fail closed.
An uncertain creation receipt remains blocked and requires a new session.

externalDependencies.boundary: ACP permission request and persistent operation receipt.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: Drive fake permission prompts and response gates; use synthetic receipts and never invoke a real provider.
